ns2:course.label: Applied Econometrics
ns2:course.description: Develops a general methodological basis for searching for quantitative economic knowledge; integrates and gives operational content to the topics of economic, statistical, and econometric theory. Prerequisite: ECON 507 or ECON 574, or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: ECON 507 or ECON 574, or equivalent.
